title: Custom eggless Father's Day cakes for Rosehill and Camellia dads
summary:
Most cakes for Father's Day get ordered the week of, then Rosehill and Camellia families find every eggless bakery already booked out.

Every cake at Num Nums is 100% eggless — not most, not some, every single one. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Ferrero Rocher and Tiramisu, and a photo topper add-on for $19.99. He gets a cake with no eggs and no idea it's missing anything.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Wigram Street, Harris Park — a short drive from Rosehill or Camellia, open until 10pm daily.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
